notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay two life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
